scope: Publish exact source/results bytes with bounded, reconstructible JSON chunks.

summary.scope: Source closure, full corner-stress/peak and work identity verification of independently assembled FEM fields
summary.limitations: This postprocessing audit does not reassemble stiffness or recompute the equilibrium residual; those are computed by the independent FEM driver and retained with its source. It does not certify continuum or coupled-contact accuracy.

limitations: Independent finite-traction FEM references on three finer CAD meshes. This combines geometry and volume changes; other error axes remain separate. Every full tensor, raw corner peak/location, work identity, original traction snapshot and source closure is retained. Complete residuals are computed by the independently assembled FEM driver. Mesh assets are already published in physical-axes-checkpoint-v1. Native finer-field, contact, profile/history and accuracy/cost acceptance remain required. JSON files above200MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original JSON exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
